Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Cora Tavan: 34-year-old man, 151 cm (very-short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: wide triangular face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; broad low bridge, full lips; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: one mismatched earring; a narrow bracelet stack; a shallow cheek scar. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
